title: Recent Advances and Opportunities of Active Materials for Haptic Technologies in Virtual and Augmented Reality
limitations: This is a comprehensive review article synthesizing existing literature and current state-of-art haptic technologies; it does not present original empirical research with statistical testing.
The paper reviews device specifications, material properties, and technical capabilities from existing studies but does not conduct new experiments with quantified statistical outcomes.
While the paper cites numerous empirical studies (192 references), it does not extract or report the statistical findings from those studies in structured form.
Descriptive tables (Table 1 on tactile sensing mechanisms, Table 2 on active material-based actuators) provide technical specifications but not statistical test results.
